research_question: Does the revised QRS coordinated-breadth admission gate recover a known-positive local-volatility proposal while retaining calibrated abstention on the predeclared holdings negative control?

setup.proposal_only_stop_rule: An ACT or candidate mutation on G- stops the frozen plan before any Worker dispatch.
setup.answer_boundary: Reused optimization diagnostics were Evolver-only; neither proposal exposed answer-rich diagnostics to a Worker or embedded them in a reusable candidate.

g_plus.gate_interpretation: The revised gate recovered the predeclared known-positive local-volatility intervention opportunity at proposal and admission time.

g_minus.gate_interpretation: The predeclared selectivity expectation failed because the gate admitted a second nonempty candidate instead of abstaining.
g_minus.label_uncertainty: The Evolver grounded a final-weight-state reconciliation relation in the holdings target and successful Brinson contrast, so the experimenter-assigned negative-control label requires re-audit before this ACT can be called a semantic false positive.

retained_conclusion: The revised QRS gate passed the predeclared proposal-recall case but failed the predeclared two-case selectivity criterion because G- also produced an admitted nonempty ACT. The frozen plan stopped before Worker evaluation, so this is gate behavior only and supplies no benchmark or candidate-quality result.

claim_boundary.supported: One known-positive proposal opportunity recovered, two legal admitted nonempty QRS proposals, local component-smoke feasibility, correct frozen-plan stop, and clean proposal-only accounting.
claim_boundary.negative_result: The predeclared selective ACT/ABSTAIN outcome was not achieved.
claim_boundary.label_limit: Because the holdings ACT included a grounded reusable relation, the negative-control label itself may be misspecified; this run alone cannot distinguish gate over-admission from a mislabeled control.
claim_boundary.not_supported: Benchmark gain, Worker activation, candidate quality, stable promotion, QRS superiority, selectivity rate, sealed performance, or component causality.
